Additionally, any novel or unexpected developments specific to key drivers of the variable in question—such as erratic behavior in critical industries or systemic shifts—could further exacerbate deviations from the forecast range. While the forecast incorporates typical volatility and patterns, these low-probability, high-impact events remain a source of potential deviation.
